scope: The identification of sex-specific peptides in human tooth enamel by nanoflow liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry (nanoLC-MS/MS)
A small fraction of the tooth enamel was abraded using fine grit sandpaper.
The abraded part of the tooth’s surface was immersed in 120 µL 5% (v/v) hydrochloric acid (1.00317.100; Merck) placed in the cap of a 0.5-mL Eppendorf microcentrifuge tube and etched for 2 min
